title: GoCar 4Hr GoCar Tour: Experience San Diego
includes: 8.75% environmental fee for carbon offset, gasoline and tire recycling
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Driver's License Required and be 21+ to Drive
policies: Optional Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) is available upon request at check-in and costs approximately $19
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This tour is essential for anyone who really wants to get out and really experience San Diego. It takes the best parts of our Downtown, Balboa and Old Town tours, and gives you plenty of time to do all three tours, while also stopping and really checking out the sights of San Diego. You will have more than enough time to park the car and tour the Maritime Museum and check out all of the ships, navigate through the unique Horton Plaza mall, and the Gaslamp Quarter to see all the sights of Downtown. From there you can peruse around Balboa park on foot and really take in the sights and sounds of Balboa and even go to one of the many museums that are always open, and stop to smell the roses in our Rose Garden with over 800 different varieties of roses. All along this tour are many great spots to stop and take pictures, eat, drink, relax and truly experience why San Diego truly is America’s Finest City.
*If booking more than 2 people please submit separate orders!
